judge.rationale: The core validation implementation in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` works properly: it compiles static schemas at registration time, caches dynamic schemas in a WeakMap, formats validation errors without leaking property values, and returns a `ToolResponse`. However, the candidate appears to have stopped mid-implementation (leaving an untracked `.lore/dod.md` artifact and half-completed checklists). Several explicit acceptance criteria are completely missing, including updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`, as well as the complete `CHANGELOG.md` entry. Additionally, `registry.test.ts` only contains a single test while the remaining unit tests (extra properties passthrough, dynamic schema changes, unknown tool throw, static compilation count) were omitted, and the orchestrator test was placed in a separate `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
